name: krpaz8-signed-in-projects
goal: A signed-in Mac home lists Tracker and Hub projects, retains healthy sources, opens projects directly, and keeps Needs you accessible.

evidence: Installed primary Mac revision 086d959532, already signed in: empty Recent projects, generic hosted error and cramped Needs you. Expected Tracker and Hub projects with open destinations and source-specific failure.

Hosted service examples omit independent source refusals. Hub authenticated routing omitted GET collection with no configured collaboration. Desktop account entry browser fixture lists Gamma only via bridge and omits Tracker and Needs you.

The unchanged narrowed unit tests reject the 503 owner response, discarded local list and unguarded local Home request on red commit 38bd6dc67c. The unchanged browser regression on harbor-mbp-2 found no Tracker project.

Owner-only Hub fallback, independent source reads, the signed-in Mac Home and Needs you use of Hub components, and the admitted native Home transport are implemented. The red source lacked the Home port.

Same unit tests, command and captured environment passed at the repair commit. The isolated app browser test on harbor-mbp-2 passed project opening, Needs you navigation, partial-source failure and sign-out.
